subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `captionedFinalText` become a supported public channel-plugin capability for changing final-mode TTS settlement and user-visible message ordering?
rationale: This is a plugin API and delivery-policy choice, not a mechanical bug fix: opting in changes whether core suppresses live text and relies on a captioned voice send plus recovery.

options.title: Adopt the generic capability
options.body: Accept `captionedFinalText` as a documented plugin contract, contingent on current-head Telegram proof and focused compatibility coverage for success, failure, cancellation, and tagged behavior.

options.title: Keep the behavior out of the public SDK
options.body: Reject the new public capability and redesign the change around an owner-approved internal seam or Telegram-specific implementation if that better matches the intended plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the generic capability
recommendation.body: Accept `captionedFinalText` as a documented plugin contract, contingent on current-head Telegram proof and focused compatibility coverage for success, failure, cancellation, and tagged behavior.
